summary: Spain does not collect ethnic statistics. The Interior Ministry publishes child victims of sexual offences and victims of online sexual offences by nationality and continent, and people detained or investigated by nationality for all victims. Family maltreatment, neglect and homicide have little or no victim nationality, and trafficking nationality is published only as a ranking.

nations.National (Interior Ministry, Ministry of: Police crime statistics (SEC) and the annual sexual-offences report; child-maltreatment register RUMI.
nations.Regions: Regional figures exist; only national totals are used here.

european_title: Not recorded by any Spanish source
european_note: Spanish official statistics record nationality (Spanish or foreign, sometimes by continent), never ethnic origin. 'Spanish' includes naturalised citizens of any origin, and 'other European citizens' are foreign nationals from Europe, so ethnic Europeans cannot be identified for victims or perpetrators.
proxy_note: Spain records nationality (Spanish or foreign, sometimes by continent), never ethnicity. Every group below is a proxy, not ethnicity.

harms.label: Sexual offences against children (police)
harms.intro: Police recorded 9,785 victimizations of children in sexual offences in 2025 (5,878 aged 0-14), with the victim's nationality and continent. People detained or investigated (14,711 in 2025) are published by nationality only for victims of all ages.

victims.scope: Spain, police-recorded victimizations of children under 18 in sexual offences, 2025
victims.rate_reason: No rates by nationality are published, and population by nationality and age was not added for this review.
victims.share_note: Interior Ministry report, child victims by nationality (0-14 plus 15-17; this edition's age bands, which differ from the 0-13 band used in the 2024 report). Continent shares are of all child victimizations; 136 foreign victims were classed as 'otros países' (stateless, unknown country or infrequent nationalities) and 4 were from Oceania, so continents do not add up to the foreign total. Victimizations, not unique children. Nationality, not ethnicity: Spanish statistics never record ethnic origin. 'Spanish' includes naturalised citizens; foreign nationals are grouped by continent of nationality.

perpetrators.scope: Spain, people detained or investigated for sexual offences, victims of all ages, 2025
perpetrators.rate_reason: No rates by nationality are published.
perpetrators.share_note: Includes 1,264 people aged 14-17. Most frequent foreign nationalities: Moroccan (1,222), Colombian (870), Peruvian (373). 37 were classed as 'otros países' and 2 were from Oceania. Not child-victim-specific. Nationality, not ethnicity: Spanish statistics never record ethnic origin. 'Spanish' includes naturalised citizens; foreign nationals are grouped by continent of nationality.

cross.text: Detainee tables are not split by the victim's age or nationality, so no victim-by-perpetrator table exists.

harms.label: Maltreatment in the family
harms.intro: Police recorded 7,427 victims under 18 of family maltreatment in 2025, with no nationality. The national child-maltreatment register (RUMI) received 28,550 notifications in 2024, split Spanish or foreign for all types of maltreatment together.

victims.scope: Spain, child-maltreatment notifications to RUMI, all types, 2024
victims.rate_reason: No rates by nationality are published.
victims.share_note: All types of maltreatment combined (physical abuse was 8,428 of 46,549 types recorded). Data quality is poor: the Balearic Islands report 0 Spanish and 5,428 foreign children, Catalonia 2,847 foreign of 3,555, and Aragón, Galicia and Melilla sent no data, so the foreign share is almost certainly overstated. Nationality, not ethnicity: Spanish statistics never record ethnic origin. 'Spanish' includes naturalised citizens; foreign nationals are grouped by continent of nationality.

harms.intro: Neglect was the most frequent type in the national child-maltreatment register (19,699 of 46,549 types recorded in 2024). Nationality is published only for all notifications together.

victims.text: RUMI gives nationality for all 28,550 notifications (61.3% Spanish, 38.7% foreign, with serious regional coding problems), not for neglect separately.

harms.label: Sexual trafficking and exploitation
harms.intro: Police recorded 374 victims of trafficking for sexual exploitation (2 minors) and 397 of sexual exploitation (13 minors) in 2025, and detained 416 and 240 people. Across all forms of trafficking and exploitation there were 1,869 victims (28 of them minors) and 1,056 detainees. The government summary gives nationality only as a ranked list.

victims.text: Only a ranking is published: trafficking victims were mostly Colombian, Venezuelan and Chinese; exploitation victims Colombian, Paraguayan and Venezuelan. Country counts are not published in the official summary, so they are not used.

perpetrators.text: Only a ranking is published: detainees were mostly Spanish, then Colombian and Venezuelan (trafficking) or Colombian and Paraguayan (exploitation).

cross.text: No table links victim and detainee nationality.

harms.label: Online sexual offences
harms.intro: Police recorded 1,557 victimizations in online sexual offences in 2025, 81% of them of minors, with nationality and continent. Detentions and investigations for child-pornography offences (710 in 2025) are split Spanish or foreign.

victims.scope: Spain, police-recorded victimizations in online sexual offences, all ages (81% minors), 2025
victims.share_note: Nationality is not split by age, but 1,268 of the 1,557 victimizations were of children. 19 foreign victims were classed as 'otros países' (stateless, unknown country or infrequent nationalities) and 2 were from Oceania, so continents do not add up to the foreign total. Nationality, not ethnicity: Spanish statistics never record ethnic origin. 'Spanish' includes naturalised citizens; foreign nationals are grouped by continent of nationality.

perpetrators.rate_reason: Rates not calculated: the table is not split by the victim's age.

Detentions and investigations for corruption of minors: 243 (50 foreign). Nationality, not ethnicity: Spanish statistics never record ethnic origin. breakdown.why: The Interior Ministry's 2025 sexual-offences report gives 9,785 child victimizations by nationality, by age band, with foreign victims by continent (Europe outside Spain separate). Detained or investigated people are given by nationality and continent, but only for all victims (14,711). No rates published.

Police victim tables give child victims of family maltreatment by age only, with no nationality. The child-protection register RUMI (28,550 notifications in 2024) gives Spanish/foreign for all types combined, with clear regional coding problems. Detained or investigated for family maltreatment by Spanish/foreign status, all victims (SEC 2025).
Neglect is the largest RUMI maltreatment type (19,699 of 46,549 types recorded in 2024); RUMI nationality is published only for all notifications combined. No data on the people responsible.

Police victim tables give child homicide victims by age only (17 victims of completed homicide under 18 in 2025, 72 including attempts). People detained or investigated for homicide are split Spanish/foreign for all victims.

CITCO's 2025 executive summary gives 771 victims of sexual trafficking and exploitation (15 minors) and 656 detainees, but nationality only as a ranked list (Colombia, Venezuela, China and Paraguay; detainees Spain first). Country counts are not published in the official summary, so they are not used.

The 2025 sexual-offences report gives 1,557 cyber-sexual victimizations by nationality and continent (81% minors, not split by age). People detained or investigated for child-pornography offences split Spanish/foreign (SEC 2025).

components.name: Victim heritage
components.full: Official data by harm that separately identify ethnic European children (e.g. White non-Hispanic, White British) alongside every other group, self-reported or official, few unknowns. Broad categories that lump ethnic Europeans with others get partial credit; proxies (nationality, citizenship, migration background, country of birth) at most 9.4 points.

components.name: Perpetrator heritage
components.full: Same standard for perpetrators: not perceived, few unknowns, ethnic Europeans separately identified. Proxies at most 9.4 points.

components.name: Coverage and missing data
components.full: Over 90% of the population covered, under 10% unknown

components.name: Rates and linkage
components.full: Rates per 100,000 possible, and victim heritage linked to perpetrator heritage

score.gold_standard: 100% means a country publishes data that separately identifies ethnic Europeans, both as perpetrators (so one can tell when they disproportionately harm a group) and as child victims (so one can tell when ethnic European children are disproportionately harmed), alongside every other group, linked victim to perpetrator, for every harm.
score.rules: Heritage is 75 of every 100 points (victims 37.5, perpetrators 37.5); coverage, rates and access share the other 25. Proxies such as nationality or migration background earn at most a quarter of the heritage points. A country with no real ethnicity data for victims or perpetrators is capped at 25%.
score.why: Spain scores 21% on the stricter scale (20-40%). The Interior Ministry publishes child victims of sexual offences by nationality and continent, people detained or investigated by nationality, and online sexual-crime victims by nationality, but nationality is a proxy and perpetrators are not split by the victim's age. Physical abuse, neglect and homicide have little or no victim origin data, and trafficking nationality is published only as a ranking.
score.weights_id: harm weights of 19 Nov 2026 (homicide 25, sexual abuse 20, sex trafficking 20, physical abuse 15, online exploitation 10, neglect 10)

onvios25.name: Informe sobre delitos contra la libertad sexual en España 2025
onvios25.publisher: Ministerio del Interior (Gabinete de Coordinación y Estudios, ONVIOS)
onvios25.records: Victimizations by age, sex and nationality (continent and country); people detained or investigated by age and nationality; online sexual offences.
onvios25.limitations: Perpetrators not split by the victim age; no rates by nationality. The PDF blocks automated downloads (Cloudflare); it was read through an ordinary public fetch. This edition's child age bands are 0-14 and 15-17 (the 2024 report used 0-13).

sec.name: Portal Estadístico de Criminalidad (SEC): detenciones e investigados por tipología penal y nacionalidad; victimizaciones por edad
sec.publisher: Ministerio del Interior (Sistema Estadístico de Criminalidad)
sec.records: Detentions and investigations by offence (all, foreign); victimizations by offence, age band and sex.
sec.limitations: Victims have no nationality; detentions are not unique people and not split by victim age.

rumi.name: Boletín de datos estadísticos de medidas de protección a la infancia y la adolescencia, n.º 27 (datos 2024), incl. RUMI
rumi.publisher: Ministerio de Juventud e Infancia (Observatorio de la Infancia)
rumi.records: Child-maltreatment notifications (RUMI) by type, region and Spanish/foreign nationality.
rumi.limitations: Nationality only for all types combined; obvious regional coding errors; three regions missing.

citco25.name: Resumen ejecutivo anual 2025 sobre la trata y la explotación de seres humanos en España
citco25.records: Victims and detainees of trafficking and sexual exploitation, minors, most frequent nationalities.
citco25.limitations: Nationality only as a ranked list; detailed country counts are not published in this summary.

availability_note: Each harm has an 'availability' map listing the victim and perpetrator groups with any published figure (overall and by measure) and any linked victim-perpetrator pairs. Groups not listed have no data for that harm; the explorer should grey them out rather than offer an empty combination.
